Name: Traditional Turkish Farmhouse
Author: KediDili
TagLine: Adds traditional Turkish style farmhouses to your game. Requires AT.
Description:
Adds traditional Turkish style farmhouses to your game. Requires AT. For now, there's just the farmhouse, but the mod will be expanded with time.

Currently, ONLY the following buildings are planned to be included in later updates:
 -Silo
 -Barns
 -Coops 
 -Cabins
 -Well
 -Stable (Of course)
 -Sheds
 -Mill

Installation
-Install latest version of SMAPI ( https://smapi.io )
-Install latest version of Alternative Textures ( https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246 )
-Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
-Run the game using SMAPI.

 If You Encounter A Bug
-Please upload your log to https://smapi.io/log and see the instructions there, then submit a bug report to this page and attach your log (and a picture, if it’s something visual). I cannot help you without a log!

-Additional Credit
-Thanks to Yri for helping me figure out how to do that roof!

Check out my other mods! => https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/profile/225898
